CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content was found.

COD.rationale: Content (identified coordinates/colour), an organizational presentation (coordinate listing and grid orientation) and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement tied to the identified content's presentation/access was found.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications (colour assignments to coordinate sets) are present for current and candidate entries.

D.rationale: The report separately records origin/status metadata (kinds of origin, record_time, represented_time) distinct from the content coordinate listings.

O.rationale: The text specifies how contents are presented (grid orientation) and lists coordinate-based presentations for specific referents.
